facts.fact: Ethio telecom's press release says it, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel signed a tripartite strategic agreement on 4 February 2026 under the Horizon Fiber Initiative for a terrestrial fibre corridor joining Djibouti's submarine cable landing stations, across Ethiopia, to Sudan's, building on a memorandum signed in Addis Ababa on 3 December 2024.

systems.owner: Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom, Sudatel Group
